headline: Superman and the Justice League Power Levels
post:
Hey superhero fans! Have you ever wondered why DC's heroes might pack a bigger punch than Earth's mightiest mortals over in Marvel? According to Screen Rant, the characters of the DC Universe are naturally more powerful due to the very nature of both realities. Back in JLA/Avengers #2, the Man of Steel famously caught Mjolnir and told Thor that "the dials go up to eleven" in his world before knocking the God of Thunder unconscious.

Beyond iconic powerhouses like Superman, Wonder Woman, and the Flash, the DC multiverse features an elaborate hierarchy of abstract realms. These successive planes of existence transcend everything beneath them, housing massive entities like Darkseid whose true form threatens every single timeline simply by falling into reality. While the Avengers and the Justice League both gather ultimate rosters to save the cosmos, DC leans heavily into these extraordinary scales of power.

Do you think the Justice League would win an ultimate rematch against the Avengers? 💥⚡️🦸‍♂️

#DCComics #Superman #JusticeLeague
original_title: Superman Already Confirmed The Real Reason DC's Heroes Will Always Be Stronger Than Marvel's

post:

headline: James Gunn and Peter Safran leaving DC Studios
post:
Big changes are happening in the superhero world. According to ComicBook.com, DC Studios co-presidents James Gunn and Peter Safran are stepping down a full year before their contracts were set to end following Warner Bros.' acquisition by Skydance. 

Reflecting on his time in a statement, Gunn shared that "only the closest people" knew how "trying" the last four years of his life had been while managing studio duties and filmmaking. Despite the departure, the filmmaker offered some exciting news. He revealed that he is currently writing a brand-new DC project, and noted that "the characters we set up will live on."

What are you hoping to see next in the DCU? 🎬

#JamesGunn #DCStudios #ManOfTomorrow
original_title: James Gunn Opens Up About “Trying” Times at DC Studios, But Confirms Third Project in the Works
